title: Mark Cuban Discusses With Snoop How He Made Billions and Purchasing The Dallas Mavericks
htmlContent:
<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/geisAnF6w9A" width="560" height="315" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="allowfullscreen"></iframe>

Mark Cuban stops by GGN NEWS to discuss how he made billions before the internet boom with Uncle Snoop.  The pair dive into how Mark was able to start his own business after being fired from janitorial work. He would connect portable computers and taught himself how to write software. Mark helped build the company from the ground up and sold Broadcast.com for $5.7 Billion to Yahoo Inc. The company was based around streaming video with audio to sports games, music, video games and we all know the rest is history.  In addition, Snoop asks Mark how he feels about the way the media portrays him to the public as a team owner. In which Mark responds by saying "I just don't care" He has been a basketball junkie since he was five years old and Mark is passionate about the sport he loves just like every one of us with our hobby of choice. The Full interview with Mark Cuban and Snoop can be streamed above. Please feel free to leave your feedback in the comment box.
